principle: Operational continuity is mandatory, but never by fabricating, imputing or silently substituting unverified market data.

requires: current legally usable and verified official/open-data observations
allows: close-based market value and unrealized P/L

forbids: market facts without a verified source

history_source_fallback_order.rule: Use any already-imported bundle only if the StockLab licensed-bundle validator passes rights, provenance, schema, checksum, PIT context and market coverage.

examples: TEJ or another contracted Taiwan data provider
history_source_fallback_order.rule: Provider identity is not enough. Exact paid entitlement must explicitly allow commercial use, automated acquisition/processing, private storage, derived analysis, public derived outputs and the actual processing location.

Use only after the exact ordered products and terms or written clarification authorize the required automated/model/derived-output use. Raw licensed rows stay private unless redistribution is explicitly granted.
Accept lawfully obtained CSV/JSON/JSONL from any provider through import-licensed-history.py only when a retained rights manifest proves the required rights. Missing datasets are not synthesized.
Keep the app operational in VERIFIED_FACTS_ONLY mode and continue lawful forward archiving. Never pretend that forward accumulation backfills missing past history.

failure_behavior.one_dataset_failure: isolate that factor and mark unavailable; do not crash unrelated verified features
failure_behavior.licensed_provider_failure: move to next authorized source candidate; never fall back to scraping
failure_behavior.missing_value: preserve null/unavailable; never replace with zero, previous value, average, median, another site or AI-generated value
